subject: Data protection confirmation: no model improvement from customer data + evidence request
messages:
From: Elena Novak <elena.novak@mediascope.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Legal Ops <mediascope.ai>
Date: 2028-07-19T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up on training-on-customer-data question + evidence request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo earlier — good conversation. A couple of items we need to lock down before we can move to procurement:

- Written confirmation that Mediascope data (API prompts, uploads, logs) will NOT be used to improve or fine-tune Redwood public models or shared model pools without an explicit, signed amendment.
- Clarify how PII is treated in logs and what redaction/sanitization controls are available.
- Retention windows for request/response logs and any KV/cache data; ability to shorten to 14 days if required.
- Access to a minimal evidence bundle (SOC2 excerpt, KMS/HSM architecture diagram, example audit log) for our security review.

We attached the draft DPA from our side for reference (Mediascope_DPA_v1.pdf). Please confirm whether Redwood can provide the above in writing and an operational checklist we can hand to our infosec team.

Appreciate a short reply with the commitments and an estimated ETA for the evidence bundle.

Regards,
Elena Novak
Head of Cloud Security
Mediascope AI

Attachment: Mediascope_DPA_v1.pdf (PDF, 186KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Novak <elena.novak@mediascope.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up on training-on-customer-data question + evidence request

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list and for sending the draft DPA. Summary answers below and next steps at the bottom.

1) No-model-learning confirmation
- Commitment: Redwood will not use any customer-provided prompts, uploads, or derived logs to train or improve our public/shared models by default. Any training on customer data requires a separate, signed agreement explicitly naming the dataset and scope.

2) PII treatment and redaction
- We do not perform automatic downstream model ingestion of data streams. For logs retained for observability, we offer configurable redaction and tokenization pipelines that can remove or mask PII at ingestion. Customer can opt-in to additional PII-scrubbing rules.

3) Retention windows
- Default: 30 days.
- Configurable: We can support a customer-configured minimum of 14 days for request/response logs and cache metadata in Dedicated/Private deployments. Hosted customers can request shorter retention under contract and subject to operational review.

4) Evidence bundle
- We can provide: SOC 2 Type II excerpt, KMS/HSM architecture summary, sample audit logs (sanitized), and a short operational checklist. SOC2 link: https://redwood.example.com/soc2/report-2028

Operational items / next steps:
- I will send a Redwood privacy commitment PDF and an operational checklist.
- Diego (cc) will prepare the evidence pack and confirm ETA.
- If Mediascope signs the DPA amendment to state \"no model learning without consent,\" we will attach that to the account and enable the non-learning flag in the tenant.

I attached our succinct privacy commitment for Mediascope to review (redwood-privacy-commitment.pdf). If that looks good we can prepare the DPA amendment and a DocuSign link.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-privacy-commitment.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Elena — looping in ops details and the checklist you asked for.

Operational checklist (high level):
- Enable tenant flag: \"no_model_learning\" (prevents routing to training pipelines).
- Configure retention: set request/response logs to 14 days (we will schedule a config push).
- Activate ingestion redaction rules: we recommend default PII rule set + Mediascope custom regex for IDs.
- KMS/HSM: confirm key wrapping requirement; we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS on hosted or HSM in Redwood Private.
- Audit artifacts: provide SOC2 excerpt, sample sanitized logs, and an architecture diagram.

ETA for evidence bundle: 48 hours (SOC2 excerpt + sanitized logs + KMS diagram). I will upload the package to a shared folder and include a ZIP stub here: evidence-pack.zip (will contain PDFs and log samples).

Questions for you to help us speed this up:
1) Security contact for Docusign routing (name + email).
2) Any custom PII patterns we should include immediately (SSN/ID formats, internal account IDs).

If you confirm the contact, I’ll generate a DocuSign envelope with the exact DPA amendment language (we will mirror your Mediascope_DPA_v1 with the non-learning clause).

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence-pack.zip (staged, will upload full ZIP)
